pages.text: The pack has four progression tiers, tracked by AStages (per-player). Advance by completing gate quests in FTB Quests.$(br2)$(bold)T1 - Foundations:$() Iron/Copper/Brass. Overworld only. Create + Botania + Iron's Spells. Common affixes only.$(br2)$(bold)T2 - Expansion:$() Steel/Manasteel. Twilight Forest, Blue Skies, Aether. Thermal + Ars Nouveau. First Simply Swords uniques.$(br2)$(bold)T3 - Dominion:$() Diamond/Terrasteel/Enderium/Osmium. Undergarden, Deeper & Darker, Nether, Abyss. Mekanism + Refined Storage + Occultism.$(br2)$(bold)T4 - Ascension:$() Netherite/Antimatter. Deep Aether, The End. MekaSuit, Mahou Tsukai, Oblivion's Rift.
